What is an AI skill?

Instead of guessing from training data, your AI can look things up — your Shopify orders, Semrush rankings, GA4 traffic, HubSpot contacts. Live data, on demand.

#why_skills_wiki.md

Managing AI skills shouldn't be a full-time job.

Most teams end up manually copying data from their tools into Claude or ChatGPT — every single session. Skills Wiki replaces that with a single connection: paste one URL once and your AI has live access to all your tools, every time you chat.

Enable or disable any skill in one click. Connect your external services once and they work across every skill. Give feedback and adjust behavior without touching any code.

✓Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any AI that supports MCP

✓Enable or disable any skill in one click — changes take effect immediately

✓All skills are auto-audited and self-healing via our Evolution Loop

The Problem

You use Claude or ChatGPT every day — but it only knows what it was trained on. Every time you need your store data, your SEO metrics, or your analytics, you're manually copy-pasting it into the chat.

The Solution

Skills Wiki connects your AI to the tools you actually use. Enable a skill in one click and your AI can pull live data from Shopify, Semrush, GA4, or HubSpot — right inside Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini. No code. No installs.

Browse 100+ skills across SEO, ecommerce, marketing, and more. Enable what you need, disable what you don't — changes take effect instantly, no AI settings to touch.
